title: ChatSection opener fetch has no timeout causing infinite loading state
reasoning: The opener fetch has no AbortController or timeout. If the /api/chat endpoint hangs (slow network, server timeout, DNS issue), the component stays in loading state indefinitely. The .catch() only handles rejections, not slow responses. Users see a loading spinner forever with no way to recover except refreshing the page.
reproduction: Configure /api/chat to delay response by 60+ seconds or block the endpoint in browser DevTools. The ChatSection shows loading spinner indefinitely.
recommendation: Add AbortController with 10-15 second timeout. On timeout, fallback to openerMessage and set loading=false. Provide user feedback ('Connection slow, using offline mode') so they understand the state.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests verify timeout handling or slow network conditions for the opener fetch.
suggestedRegressionTest: Mock /api/chat to delay 20 seconds. Verify component shows fallback message after timeout and allows user interaction.
minimumFixScope: src/src/components/portal/BasePortal.tsx ChatSection useEffect - add timeout handling to opener fetch
